title: Final review of the deletion diff
description: Review the full deletion diff. The checklist is what must SURVIVE, not what went: tk builds and its tests pass; internal/tkcontract is untouched; relay and dashboard still work and how they get run state is stated; no .tick/ read was left orphaned; and nothing was deleted that ticfac does not actually provide — check each removed command against its ticfac equivalent rather than trusting the plan. Verify a claimed defect against the base commit before any repair is built on it.
